I'd estimate only about 20-30 can be found today. None of those OVAs. It's sad. I should've done better backups. I was going so slow with mine. I had my NAS for 5 years when my anime HDD died but I had only backed up like 40% because I was so slow to do it. I hope that someday I'll get it all back.

And it was also still easy to find older anime in those days. 2018 in particular is when I remember getting a lot of older anime's BD rips from groups like DOKI. Most their stuff is impossible to find now. It's so sad how we let so much anime just disappear. Looking at my 2016 list, those 80 anime

I didn't engage much with people. I wasn't super active in the larger anime community but I think that's why I was able to enjoy everything so much, even the meh shows like Matoi. I wish I could go back to those times. Watching anime 5+ hours a day, my health not as bad as it is now.

Looking back at it all now, the memories of those days flooded in quick. It doesn't seem that long ago because COVID fucked with time. 2016 was a rather light year for me as far as number of anime. So many bad anime I forced myself to watch. But I regret none of it. I truly enjoyed that era.

I made myself sad. After watching Orgel again, I went through my 2016 anime watch list. I watched 80 anime that year (including like 3 movies and 5 or 6 OVAs) and rewatched about a dozen. I kept strict track of everything I watched and exactly when. Because of my autism. But I'm so glad I did that.
